authority_boundary.name: Human Authority
authority_boundary.description: External authority boundary; not a seventh JAI layer.

layers.name: Intent and Context
layers.acceptance_question: Is the intended outcome, accountable authority, scope and material context explicit?

layers.name: Meaning and Domain Model
layers.acceptance_question: Do all parties mean the same thing and is uncertainty represented?

layers.name: Reasoning, Policy and Control
layers.acceptance_question: Are decisions, policy constraints, evidence obligations, trade-offs and escalation rules justified?

layers.name: Solution Design
layers.acceptance_question: Does the design satisfy the accepted semantics and controls without inventing new facts?

layers.name: Realisation and Tooling
layers.acceptance_question: Is the design implemented through permitted tools and bounded execution mechanisms?

layers.name: Execution and Evidence
layers.acceptance_question: Is the observable result evidenced, attributable, reproducible and suitable for authority review?
